definition: a blue bird with a crest
description: An autumn picnic in strong wind. A blue jay with a pointed blue crest, blue-and-white barred wings and a black collar stands on a glazed doughnut on a paper plate on a wooden picnic table, beak wide open as if it is screeching. Paper plates and a red checked blanket blow off the table, orange leaves swirl and another jay flies past in the sky. A cut cake with blue icing sits at the end of the table. A row of grey squirrels sits on the bench, seen from behind, staring up at the bird, and one climbs onto the table.
